title: Continuous module sections and their canonical scalar extension
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with its small pro-étale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $T$ be a topological commutative ring and $M$ a topological $T$-module: addition, negation and scalar multiplication are continuous. Over the continuous coefficient ring sheaf $T_X$ of [def-weil-pbc-lisse-lattice-coefficients], define the presheaf of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] $\mathcal C_X(T,M)$ by $\mathcal C_X(T,M)(U)=C(|U|,M)$ with pointwise action $(af)(x)=a(x)f(x)$, and restriction by precomposition along every site arrow. When its underlying additive presheaf satisfies the sheaf condition, denote that specified sheaf of modules by the same symbol. For $X:\mathrm{Scheme}_u$ and $T,M:\mathrm{Type}_v$, use $\mathrm{ULift}_{u+1}C(|U|,T)$ and $\mathrm{ULift}_{u+1}C(|U|,M)$ in universe $\max(u+1,v)$, without changing the small site's universes. For a topological field $K$ and subring $A\subseteq K$ with subspace topology, the coefficient map $A_X\to K_X$ is postcomposition with inclusion. For a sheaf $F$ of $A_X$-modules, use the existing sectionwise scalar-extension presheaf $U\mapsto K_X(U)\otimes_{A_X(U)}F(U)$ and its sheaf change of rings [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], with the canonical unit from the presheaf to its sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification].
